concepts.title: Dataset
concepts.summary: A collection of examples used to teach or evaluate a model.

concepts.title: Features and Labels
concepts.summary: The inputs a model sees and the answers it learns to predict.

concepts.title: Model
concepts.summary: A function with learnable parameters that maps features to predictions.

concepts.title: Training vs. Inference
concepts.summary: Learning parameters from data versus using them to predict.

concepts.title: Supervised Learning
concepts.summary: Learning from examples that include the correct answer.

concepts.title: Unsupervised Learning
concepts.summary: Finding structure in data without labeled answers.

concepts.title: Neural Networks
concepts.summary: Layered models that learn hierarchical representations.

concepts.title: Loss Function
concepts.summary: A number that measures how wrong the model's predictions are.

concepts.title: Gradient Descent
concepts.summary: Iteratively adjusting parameters downhill along the loss gradient.

concepts.title: Learning Rate
concepts.summary: The step size taken on each gradient descent update.

concepts.title: Overfitting
concepts.summary: Memorizing training data at the cost of generalization.

concepts.title: Regularization
concepts.summary: Techniques that penalize complexity to improve generalization.

concepts.title: Train/Validation/Test Split
concepts.summary: Separating data to train, tune, and honestly evaluate.

concepts.title: Confusion Matrix
concepts.summary: A table of prediction outcomes against true classes.

concepts.title: Precision vs. Recall
concepts.summary: Two complementary views of a classifier's mistakes.
